description: Long-term charging trends: energy, cost and session frequency.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(energy_kwh) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring}

SELECT SUM(COALESCE(cost, est_cost)) AS value FROM (SELECT z.*, CASE WHEN z.energy_kwh > 0 AND z.rate_s IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(z.energy_kwh::numeric * z.rate_s::numeric, 2) END AS est_cost FROM (SELECT y.*, CASE WHEN y.loc_id IS NOT NULL THEN y.loc_rate WHEN y.is_home_s THEN (SELECT rate_per_kwh FROM saved_locations WHERE is_home ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) END AS rate_s FROM (SELECT x.*, COALESCE(NOT COALESCE(x.is_public, false) AND (COALESCE(x.is_home_charger, false) OR x.charger_type = 'wallbox' OR COALESCE(x.loc_is_home, false) OR x.near_wb), false) AS is_home_s FROM (SELECT s.*, l.id AS loc_id, l.name AS loc_name, l.is_home AS loc_is_home, l.rate_per_kwh AS loc_rate, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallboxes w WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND w.latitude IS NOT NULL AND w.longitude IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.latitude - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(w.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.longitude - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= 0.15) AS near_wb FROM charging_sessions s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sl.* FROM saved_locations sl WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND s.lon IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= sl.radius_m / 1000.0 ORDER BY 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) / (sl.radius_m / 1000.0), sl.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true) x) y) z) AS charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} HAVING COUNT(COALESCE(cost, est_cost)) > 0

SELECT date_trunc('week', started_at) AS time, SUM(energy_kwh) FILTER (WHERE is_home_s) AS "Home (kWh)", SUM(energy_kwh) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_home_s) AS "Away (kWh)" FROM (SELECT z.*, CASE WHEN z.energy_kwh > 0 AND z.rate_s IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(z.energy_kwh::numeric * z.rate_s::numeric, 2) END AS est_cost FROM (SELECT y.*, CASE WHEN y.loc_id IS NOT NULL THEN y.loc_rate WHEN y.is_home_s THEN (SELECT rate_per_kwh FROM saved_locations WHERE is_home ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) END AS rate_s FROM (SELECT x.*, COALESCE(NOT COALESCE(x.is_public, false) AND (COALESCE(x.is_home_charger, false) OR x.charger_type = 'wallbox' OR COALESCE(x.loc_is_home, false) OR x.near_wb), false) AS is_home_s FROM (SELECT s.*, l.id AS loc_id, l.name AS loc_name, l.is_home AS loc_is_home, l.rate_per_kwh AS loc_rate, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallboxes w WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND w.latitude IS NOT NULL AND w.longitude IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.latitude - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(w.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.longitude - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= 0.15) AS near_wb FROM charging_sessions s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sl.* FROM saved_locations sl WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND s.lon IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= sl.radius_m / 1000.0 ORDER BY 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) / (sl.radius_m / 1000.0), sl.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true) x) y) z) AS charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('week', started_at) AS time, SUM(COALESCE(cost, est_cost)) AS "Cost" FROM (SELECT z.*, CASE WHEN z.energy_kwh > 0 AND z.rate_s IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(z.energy_kwh::numeric * z.rate_s::numeric, 2) END AS est_cost FROM (SELECT y.*, CASE WHEN y.loc_id IS NOT NULL THEN y.loc_rate WHEN y.is_home_s THEN (SELECT rate_per_kwh FROM saved_locations WHERE is_home ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) END AS rate_s FROM (SELECT x.*, COALESCE(NOT COALESCE(x.is_public, false) AND (COALESCE(x.is_home_charger, false) OR x.charger_type = 'wallbox' OR COALESCE(x.loc_is_home, false) OR x.near_wb), false) AS is_home_s FROM (SELECT s.*, l.id AS loc_id, l.name AS loc_name, l.is_home AS loc_is_home, l.rate_per_kwh AS loc_rate, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallboxes w WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND w.latitude IS NOT NULL AND w.longitude IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.latitude - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(w.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.longitude - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= 0.15) AS near_wb FROM charging_sessions s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sl.* FROM saved_locations sl WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND s.lon IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= sl.radius_m / 1000.0 ORDER BY 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) / (sl.radius_m / 1000.0), sl.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true) x) y) z) AS charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(COALESCE(cost, est_cost)) > 0 ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(energy_kwh) FILTER (WHERE is_home_s) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(energy_kwh), 0) AS value FROM (SELECT z.*, CASE WHEN z.energy_kwh > 0 AND z.rate_s IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(z.energy_kwh::numeric * z.rate_s::numeric, 2) END AS est_cost FROM (SELECT y.*, CASE WHEN y.loc_id IS NOT NULL THEN y.loc_rate WHEN y.is_home_s THEN (SELECT rate_per_kwh FROM saved_locations WHERE is_home ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) END AS rate_s FROM (SELECT x.*, COALESCE(NOT COALESCE(x.is_public, false) AND (COALESCE(x.is_home_charger, false) OR x.charger_type = 'wallbox' OR COALESCE(x.loc_is_home, false) OR x.near_wb), false) AS is_home_s FROM (SELECT s.*, l.id AS loc_id, l.name AS loc_name, l.is_home AS loc_is_home, l.rate_per_kwh AS loc_rate, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallboxes w WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND w.latitude IS NOT NULL AND w.longitude IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.latitude - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(w.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.longitude - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= 0.15) AS near_wb FROM charging_sessions s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sl.* FROM saved_locations sl WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND s.lon IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= sl.radius_m / 1000.0 ORDER BY 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) / (sl.radius_m / 1000.0), sl.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true) x) y) z) AS charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring}
SELECT rate_per_kwh AS value FROM saved_locations WHERE is_home ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

panels.title: Home Rate
panels.description: Rate of the first saved location marked as home. Other locations have their own rates; see Cost by Location.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(loc_name, CASE WHEN is_home_s THEN 'Home' WHEN is_public THEN 'Public' ELSE 'Other' END) AS location, SUM(energy_kwh) AS "Energy" FROM (SELECT z.*, CASE WHEN z.energy_kwh > 0 AND z.rate_s IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(z.energy_kwh::numeric * z.rate_s::numeric, 2) END AS est_cost FROM (SELECT y.*, CASE WHEN y.loc_id IS NOT NULL THEN y.loc_rate WHEN y.is_home_s THEN (SELECT rate_per_kwh FROM saved_locations WHERE is_home ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) END AS rate_s FROM (SELECT x.*, COALESCE(NOT COALESCE(x.is_public, false) AND (COALESCE(x.is_home_charger, false) OR x.charger_type = 'wallbox' OR COALESCE(x.loc_is_home, false) OR x.near_wb), false) AS is_home_s FROM (SELECT s.*, l.id AS loc_id, l.name AS loc_name, l.is_home AS loc_is_home, l.rate_per_kwh AS loc_rate, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallboxes w WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND w.latitude IS NOT NULL AND w.longitude IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.latitude - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(w.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.longitude - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= 0.15) AS near_wb FROM charging_sessions s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sl.* FROM saved_locations sl WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND s.lon IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= sl.radius_m / 1000.0 ORDER BY 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) / (sl.radius_m / 1000.0), sl.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true) x) y) z) AS charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(loc_name, CASE WHEN is_home_s THEN 'Home' WHEN is_public THEN 'Public' ELSE 'Other' END) AS "Location", COUNT(*) AS "Sessions", ROUND(SUM(energy_kwh)::numeric, 1) AS "Energy (kWh)", MAX(rate_s) AS "Rate / kWh", SUM(COALESCE(cost, est_cost)) AS "Cost (est.)" FROM (SELECT z.*, CASE WHEN z.energy_kwh > 0 AND z.rate_s IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(z.energy_kwh::numeric * z.rate_s::numeric, 2) END AS est_cost FROM (SELECT y.*, CASE WHEN y.loc_id IS NOT NULL THEN y.loc_rate WHEN y.is_home_s THEN (SELECT rate_per_kwh FROM saved_locations WHERE is_home ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) END AS rate_s FROM (SELECT x.*, COALESCE(NOT COALESCE(x.is_public, false) AND (COALESCE(x.is_home_charger, false) OR x.charger_type = 'wallbox' OR COALESCE(x.loc_is_home, false) OR x.near_wb), false) AS is_home_s FROM (SELECT s.*, l.id AS loc_id, l.name AS loc_name, l.is_home AS loc_is_home, l.rate_per_kwh AS loc_rate, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wallboxes w WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND w.latitude IS NOT NULL AND w.longitude IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.latitude - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(w.latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(w.longitude - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= 0.15) AS near_wb FROM charging_sessions s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sl.* FROM saved_locations sl WHERE s.lat IS NOT NULL AND s.lon IS NOT NULL AND 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) <= sl.radius_m / 1000.0 ORDER BY 6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lat - s.lat) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(s.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(sl.lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(sl.lon - s.lon) / 2), 2))) / (sl.radius_m / 1000.0), sl.id DESC LIMIT 1) l ON true) x) y) z) AS charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST
